[[Icefiend]]s can be assigned by [[Turael]]/[[Aya]] and [[Spria]]. They are the weakest type of [[fiend]], and commonly drop nothing but [[Fiendish ashes]]. They are generally only killed on slayer tasks, except by players trying to obtain [[Tooth half of key (moon key)|moon key halves]] in the [[Ruins of Tapoyauik]]. Although not very commonly, they also drop [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy clue scrolls]].

Due to the low amounts of icefiends assigned per task, most players choose to complete this task nearby teleports such as [[Lassar Teleport]], rather than travelling to the [[Ruins of Tapoyauik]] for the additional drops.
